title: Runkeeper Activity Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=runkeeper:activity
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(route_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Runkeeper activity events land each day and how many distinct route values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Runkeeper activity records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct route values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It steadily how much Runkeeper activity activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
